checks.name: a ```json fence quoted inside the reviewer's reasoning no longer stops the review; the captured 2026-11-14 output parses
checks.details: Before the fix, replaying the exact text the review step received on the failed /Users/mac/Downloads/test takeover (7.9k chars of reasoning quoting the instruction's ```json fence, then the answer's fence) through parseReview threw 'The reviewer did not return a JSON object with the reviewed intake files.' — the fence regex matched from the quoted fence into the answer's opening fence and captured prose. After the fix: resultText (lib/takeover-host.js) reads only the answer blocks of the subagent result (reasoning/thinking blocks are read when a result has nothing else), and parseReview scans the ```json fences from the last backwards and takes the first that parses. test/takeover-host.test.js parses the exact captured output (test/fixtures/reviewer-output-with-reasoning.txt) and asserts the reviewed draft carries .awr/intake/work-ledger.yaml with status needs_confirmation, and a block-level test pins that reasoning and thinking blocks are left out of resultText.
criteria:
1. A reviewer whose reasoning quotes the instruction's ```json fence no longer stops the takeover: resultText reads only the answer blocks of the subagent result, and parseReview takes the first ```json fence that parses to a JSON object with generated_files, scanning from the last fence backwards; the output captured from the failed takeover of 2026-11-14 (/Users/mac/Downloads/test, reasoning of 7.9k chars with the quoted fence) parses and yields .awr/intake/work-ledger.yaml.
2. A result with only reasoning blocks still fails with the same review_failed message, a missing generated_files keeps its own message, and the whole suite passes.

checks.name: failure messages and the suite are unchanged where behavior must not change

Not covered: the fixed plugin was not re-run through a live desktop-app takeover; that verification happens when the test conversation updates to the release that carries this fix and resumes its stopped takeover.
